summary: This informational memo records requirements from 3GPP Release 5 for SIP. 3GPP chose SIP as the session setup protocol for the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS), and some of its needs were not met by SIP at the time.

eli5.summary: A phone standards group chose SIP for its multimedia network and listed what it still needed from SIP. This document passes that wish list to the IETF.
